firm_data.firm_description: Counsel Press, established in 1938, is a national provider of appellate services and technology-enabled litigation support, offering expertise in state and federal appellate courts across all 50 states, including the U.S. Supreme Court.
notable_facts: Largest and most experienced appellate services provider in the nation.
Trusted partner of 100% of the Am Law 100 firms.
Built on 80 years of Counsel Press legacy.
Acquired Record Press and Appellate Innovations in August 2025.
technology_signals: Expert-designed litigation tech using software and AI tools.
Dispute management platform for case organization and compliance.

email.subject: AI for Counsel Press: built for appellate tech leaders
email.body:
Hi Maria,

Counsel Press has spent 80+ years building the nation's most trusted appellate services operation, and your recent pivot to expert-designed litigation tech with AI tools signals you're thinking ahead about how technology scales quality across state and federal courts.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of specialized practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional leaders. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping appellate and litigation support teams compete at scale.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
